verdict.rationale: Entra's own docs confirm an application gallery for SSO: vendors can request SAML/OIDC-enabled apps be added to it, and admins can start managing integrated cloud apps right away. The named SaaS apps (Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow) are cited for provisioning, not specifically SSO. Nothing in the pack shows the catalog's size or how fast an integration takes to set up. Missing for 10: evidence the gallery holds thousands of pre-built SAML/OIDC integrations, evidence that setup takes minutes rather than a custom project, independent or hands-on corroboration of catalog coverage.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the SSO catalog covers my stack — thousands of pre-built SAML/OIDC app integrations that connect in minutes, not custom projects

citations.quote: a SAML / OIDC enabled application to be added to the gallery for SSO
